name: Shimshai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe write against Jerusalem, joined by the very nations the Assyrian king had set in the cities of Samaria.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building

points: When the letter is read, Rehum and Shimshai go up in haste to Jerusalem and make the Jews cease by force and power.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building
